name: Boukoku no Otome Kishi
source:
"The Maiden Knight of the Lost Kingdom" is a kingdom about to be destroyed by war.
This is a work where you can enjoy watching a princess and a female knight being raped.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ165399.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
《亡国的少女骑士》讲述了一个即将被战争摧毁的王国。

本作可以欣赏公主与女骑士遭到强暴的情节。
